name: There Will Be Beauty
source:
Ester has found herself inside a vast manor in the mountainside, unable to recall why she made the treacherous climb to these dark, cold peaks. 

Upon waking she is beckoned forth by a ghastly spirit and faced with a choice: remain in the manor, navigating the depths of its dark past to discover why it is she's here- or make a quick escape from its mysterious thrall.

[From [url=https://voidblob-coop.itch.io/there-will-be-beauty]itch.io[/url]]
